question: Under what duration of practice are old age and death destroyed?
premises: Practice is undertaken for one year.
When that practice has been done, a condition arises.
Old age and death are destroyed under that condition.
inference: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The subject of abhyasta is not explicit in this verse.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
